title: Technician Efficiency report shows Customer, Technician and Date filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the Technician Efficiency report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. The Technician Efficiency report shows three filter buttons: Customer, Technician and Date, on both the Invoiced and Completed tabs.
2. The report has two view tabs: Invoiced and Completed; the same three filter buttons appear on each.
3. 'Technician' is spelled correctly here (unlike the Work Orders list, see the spelling note).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6 #4 and #5
notes: Design-only. Covers both Invoiced and Completed tabs (same chips). Option lists pending Branko's PRD.
